metadata.release_label: Philippine Standard Geographic Code as of 30 June 2026
metadata.matching_method: Exact normalized barangay name only; no fuzzy matching

geometry_status_definitions.PRESERVED_UNAFFECTED_SOURCE_GEOMETRY: The existing unaffected source geometry is preserved byte-for-value after JSON decoding; only metadata is added.
geometry_status_definitions.PENDING_VALIDATED_SOURCE: No geometry is included until a trustworthy current boundary source is obtained.

metadata.correspondence_code_note: The official PSA city listing does not display correspondence codes for Barangay 176-A through Barangay 176-F; those values are null and were not inferred.
